district_name: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(G) inventory: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District, a union elementary district (16 V.S.A. section 748) in the Orleans Central Supervisory Union (member towns: Albany, Barton, Brownington, Glover, Irasburg, Westmore, plus the former Orleans Incorporated School District area within Barton). Operational July 1, 2019; operates PK-8. A vote on merging this district with the Lake Region Union High School District into a proposed Orleans Central UUSD is scheduled November 3, 2026 -- pending, not the current structure.
Orleans Central Supervisory Union (official site; hosts both Lake Region districts' documents).

board.org_name: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School Board

sources.note: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District: fourteen directors -- two per member area (Albany, Barton, Brownington, Glover, Irasburg, Westmore, and the former Orleans ISD area) -- elected by the whole district electorate at a single floor annual meeting with seats allocated by residency (16 V.S.A. section 748 modified at-large; March 9, 2026 warning, Article 6). Only the six members whose published terms run past March 2026 are minted; the eight seats whose terms expired in 2026 are HELD pending the March 9, 2026 annual meeting minutes and the March 30, 2026 reorganization minutes (per the OCSU Live Feed, the Albany, Westmore and Orleans seats were still unfilled after that meeting). Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District 2025-2026 Annual Report (official, via OCSU): board roster with "TERM EXPIRES" as published -- Albany: Neil Urie 2026, Dan Roock 2027; Barton: Freddi Very 2028, Jessica Torrence* 2026; Brownington: Debbie Brunelle 2027, Amber Hastings* 2026; Glover: Krista Mayer 2026, Sarah Elliott 2027; Irasburg: Tiffany Ovitt 2028, Brian Arant* 2026; Orleans: Samantha Johnson* 2026, Matthew Lapham* 2026; Westmore: Megan Valley 2027, Kalli Lafebvre 2026 (*appointed for 2025-2026). Its warning for the March 9, 2026 annual meeting (Article 6) elects eight directors by residency seat from the district's legal voters at a single floor meeting.

LRUEMSD 2024-2025 Annual Report (official): the prior-year roster corroborates the 2025 elections -- Very re-elected to 2028, Ovitt (appointed for 2024-2025) elected to 2028, and the vacant Glover seat filled by Sarah Elliott to 2027 per the 2025 warning's Glover two-year term; the OCSU Live Feed confirms the Albany, Westmore and Orleans seats were left unfilled at the March 9, 2026 meeting.

Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District annual meeting minutes, March 9, 2026 (official; signed by District Clerk Shelia R. Martin and accepted by Moderator Kristin Atwood; hosted on the Orleans Central SU site and supplied by Lisa Worden, OCSU, on 2026-10-26). Article 6 warned seven seats. Outcomes: Krista Mayer (Glover) elected to a three-year term; Brian Arant (Irasburg) to a three-year term; Samantha Johnson (former Orleans ISD) elected -- the warning framed a ONE-year term while the minutes' outcome sentence says 'two-year term'; the warned term governs and her end is recorded as 2027 (Walter's ruling, 2026-10-26; conflict disclosed). Megan Valley, already seated for Westmore to 2027, was elected to the Brownington two-year seat, and her membership is extended to 2028. Article 6B (former Barton ISD, two-year term) is internally inconsistent as written — the nomination recorded is Bernard White, Jr. (motion carried) but the outcome sentence names Jessica Torrence as elected. RESOLVED 2026-10-26 on Walter's ruling: the Torrence sentence is a clerk's mis-type (she was the outgoing holder; her term ended at this meeting and she did not stand again), and the district's current official roster lists White for the seat, term expiring 2028; White is minted ELECTED end '2028'. The Albany seat was left vacant when Neil Urie declined and the Westmore seat when Kalli Lafebvre declined; Matt Lapham (Orleans) also departed after March 9, 2026, and the district's roster shows the Orleans seat expiring 2027 as Vacant. The Albany three-year seat (Urie declined) and the Westmore three-year seat (Lafebvre declined) were left VACANT, nominations tabled.

directors.name: Samantha Johnson
directors.note: Former Orleans Incorporated School District seat; elected March 9, 2026 (annual meeting minutes, Article 6F). TERM CONFLICT DISCLOSED: the warned article framed a one-year term; the minutes' outcome sentence says 'two-year term'. The warned term governs -- end recorded as 2027 under Walter's ruling of 2026-10-26. The build's earlier OCSU Live Feed note said the Orleans seat was left unfilled at this meeting; the signed minutes record her election and govern.

directors.name: Bernard White, Jr.
directors.note: Former Barton Incorporated School District seat; elected March 9, 2026 to a two-year term. The signed minutes (Article 6B) record Megan Valley nominating him and the motion carrying, but the outcome sentence names 'Jessica Torrence' as elected — ruled a clerk's mis-type by Walter on 2026-10-26: Torrence was the outgoing holder, her term ended at that meeting, and she did not stand for re-election. The district's current official roster lists White for the seat (term expiring 2028). He also holds a Lake Region UHS seat (elected 2026, end 2029) on the same person record.

sources.note: Orleans Central SU, School Board Members page (official; read 2026-10-26): the district's current roster lists Bernard White for the Barton seat, term expiring 2028, and shows the Brownington (2028), Glover (2027), Orleans (2027) and Westmore (2029) seats as Vacant. Jessica Torrence appears nowhere on it — she was the outgoing Barton holder whose term ended at the March 9, 2026 meeting and who did not stand for re-election.
